searchText: A technical deep dive into the** Portal Network with Piper Merriam** https://youtu.be/YzL2GmxA6Wk Hi everyone! I'm officially starting my apprenticeship this week and looking forward to learning and growing my network 😌 woohoo! welcome Are all of the project ideas here (https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-one/issues) still relevant for me to possibly choose to contribute to for my project? I'm finding myself getting a bit lost in the sea of project possibilities so I think working off this list will be most beneficial to me. <@!893550372885504070> you can go through the projects done in cohort-zero to get a better context. https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-zero/ few of my favourites from cohort-zero https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-zero/blob/main/notes/norswap.md https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-zero/blob/main/notes/ogenev.md Welcome Taylor 👋🏾. If you’re interested, we need some light client infrastructure built, you can start here if you’d like: https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-one/blob/master/notes/Light-Clients-R%26D.md
